findings.title: A Background held unsaved when the sheet closes, after someone else changed it, is not saved and the notice asks for a field that is no longer on screen
findings.where: scripts/sheet.mjs:90-94 (the close saves through saveBiography); scripts/sheet-sidebar.mjs:1027-1031 (the conflict writes nothing and keeps the text on the app), :1093-1094 (a later draw puts the held text back); lang/en.json:509 DRPG.Sheet.biographyChanged
findings.what_happens: The close hook calls saveBiography(app). When the stored Background differs from the base the typing began from, the save writes nothing, keeps the typed text on app._drpgBiography with the new base and warns 'click outside the field again to save it over theirs'. After a close there is no field: the text waits on the closed sheet object, comes back only if the same sheet is opened again, and is gone if the page reloads before that.

l1.what: Whether a Background held unsaved after a conflict survives a close
recipe: 1. A GM and a player who owns a student, the student's sheet open on both.
2. The player types a sentence into Background and does not leave the field.
3. The GM changes one word of the same Background and leaves the field (saved).
4. The player closes the sheet with its X: note the notice's words.
5. The player opens the sheet again: note whether the typed sentence is in the field; then leave the field and read the stored Background.
6. Repeat 1-4, then reload the player's page before reopening: note what the field holds.
l1.settles_if: agrees: the text comes back on a reopen and is saved on the next leave, and the notice says the text is kept; defect: the text is gone on a reopen, or after a reload, with no word
